docs.text:
Srinivasa Iyengar’s picture of Vedic society, its religion, learning, family and village life as the mantras of the Veda show them (Madras, 1912). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: History of the Indian people. Life in ancient India in the age of the mantras · Srinivasa Iyengar, P. T., 1863-1931 · 1912, 160 scanned pages. Published 1912; P. T. Srinivasa Iyengar died 1931; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
